newsitem.title: UK: N. Foods, Unigate gain on Hoare upgrade.
newsitem.headline: N. Foods, Unigate gain on Hoare upgrade.

text.p: Shares in Northern Foods Plc and Unigate Group Plc rose after ABN AMRO Hoare Govett upgraded profit forecasts because of a reduction in raw milk costs.

Milk Marque, the dairy farmers' co-operative, published its initial price offers for the current sales round on Thursday. Milk Marque cut its price for the standard grade ex-farm milk to 22.5p per litre from the 24.5p a litre set in the January round, analysts said.
Northern Foods rose 7-1/2p to 213p after Hoare raised its forecasts by about two percent from 142 million stg for 1997 and by the same amount from 152 million stg for next year.
Unigate was 9-1/2p ahead at 498p. Hoare lifted its forecasts by the same two percent on figures for the next two years of 140 million and 152 million stg, dealers said.
